## Names

<a id="ai_attack_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_facing_table`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L6) `$26D5-$2724`

*data*

Attack choice when the fighters have different facings. Index = distance + $33 + random spread: $08-$32 opponent behind, $33-$47 in front. Values are move commands. Entries 0-7 and $4f are never read.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$24F8`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L323)

<a id="ai_attack_same_facing_table"></a>
### [`ai_attack_same_facing_table`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L18) `$2725-$2773`

*data*

Attack choice when both fighters have the same facing. Index = distance + $29 + random spread: $08-$28 opponent in front, $29-$47 behind. Entries 0-7 are never read.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_update`](ai_opponent.md#ai_update) [`$2554`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L381)

<a id="ai_special_jump_table"></a>
### [`ai_special_jump_table`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L30) `$2774-$2787`

*data*

Addresses of the special actions 1-9; entry 0 ($0000) is never used. Read at $268b and $2690.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent.md#ai_dispatch_special) [`$268B`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L580), [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent.md#ai_dispatch_special) [`$2690`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L582), [`ai_dispatch_special`](ai_opponent.md#ai_dispatch_special) [`$2690`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L582) (+1)

### [`ai_special_by_move`](../../../src/ai_tables.asm#L35) `$2788-$27A0`

*data*

Special action (1-9, 0 = none) against each opponent move $00-$18. Move $0e, the flying kick, gets special action 9.
